title: Ad Astra: Recycling
description: The rockets can now be disassembled.
body:
Now you can melt rockets and other items from the **Ad Astra** mod back into ingots.

![rocket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb34e2f282ac355a1a29fe8b890b918a584e218d.jpeg)
